steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Cell division: is how organisms grow and repair damaged tissues. New cells are produced when existing cells divide. In humans, this happens constantly - for example, your skin cells divide every few hours to replace worn-out cells. | Chromosomes: are structures in the nucleus that contain DNA (genetic material). Human body cells have 46 chromosomes (23 pairs). Sex cells (gametes) have 23 chromosomes (one of each pair).

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Describe the stages of the cell cycle. (3 marks) | How many chromosomes are in a human body cell? | Explain why mitosis is important for growth and repair. (3 marks)
